scope: Template-free A5 Coxeter discovery via float64 L-BFGS + ERMoE ETF, continuous non-finite SO(3) Lie rotation gauge, memory-15108 algebraic closure defect, and T6 finite-sample empirical concentration

HTF.1.claim: Template-free spectral_alm_lbfgs_etf (given only abstract Coxeter orders s^2=1, t^3=1, (st)^5=1, ZERO phi/psi template) discovers exact A5 unitary representations with hom_err < 1e-10, achieves L5..L32_bacc >= 0.999, and post-hoc exhibits both Galois 5-cycle traces |Tr - phi| < 1e-5 and |Tr - psi| < 1e-5.
HTF.1.pass_if: hom_err < 1e-10 AND min_bacc >= 0.999 AND galois_phi_err < 1e-5 AND galois_psi_err < 1e-5

HTF.2.claim: Zero-replay Phase-2 continual retention on A5 Keep {e, C2, C3} after fine-tuning {C5+, C5-}: template-free spectral_alm_lbfgs_etf achieves forgetting_after_keep >= 0.99 (drop <= 0.01), beating spectral_alm_adam_linear by >= +0.50 and matching icosahedral_ermoe_etf within 0.01.

HTF.3.claim: Continuous non-finite Lie group SO(3) 3D rotations (L=4..32 generalization + disjoint geodesic-angle band continual learning): so3_gauge_ermoe_etf achieves L32_bacc >= 0.99, R2_cos >= 0.999, and zero-replay Keep {0,1,2} retention >= 0.99 after fine-tuning {3,4}, beating cayley_ufr_soft and mlp_sequence by >= +0.30 on both L32 and retention.
HTF.3.pass_if: L32_bacc >= 0.99 AND R2_cos >= 0.999 AND keeping >= 0.99 AND min_margin >= 0.30

HTF.4.claim: memory 15108 algebraic closure seam & T6 finite-sample concentration: (a) commuting invariant observable algebra gives 0 commutator/quotient defect (< 1e-12), while broken non-commuting G(lambda) / non-algebra subspace exhibits > 0.05 defect; (b) empirical 3:1 noisy channel identification failure across N in {10,25,50,100,250,500} satisfies empirical_err <= 1/(4*N*delta^2) at all N (0 violations) and <= 0.01 at N=250.
HTF.4.pass_if: commuting_defect < 1e-12 AND broken_defect > 0.05 AND t6_chebyshev_violations == 0 AND n250_err <= 0.01
